seats.notes: …Torch and Spidery Grasp as removal, and Somberwald Spiders, Voiceless Spirits, Abbey Griffin and Gallows Warden for evasion. Cut the second Caravan Vigil, Gnaw, Paraselene, Wreath, Full Moon's Rise and the blue and black cards. Lands are 9 Forest and 8 Plains, since green carries GGG and GG costs.

Blue-black tempo-midrange: cheap creatures, Stitched Drakes and Fensnakes for bodies, Tribute, Sever, Dissipate and Delusion for interaction. Cut the weak Curses, Bitterheart Witch, Trepanation Blade and the other equipment to make room for 23 spells.

…of Dread as answers, with Geist, Moon Heron, Chapel-style spirits and two Thraben Purebloods as bodies. Cut Selhoff Occultist, Dissipate, Dream Twist, Forbidden Alchemy, Frightful Delusion, Spectral Flight-level filler and the red hedge cards; 9 Plains and 8 Islands match the white-heavy pool.

Green-white deck: 16 creatures with a low curve, plus Prey Upon x2, Smite, Rebuke and tricks for interaction. Cut Mulch, Ranger's Guile, Spidery Grasp and the weaker auras and equipment; 9 Forest and 8 Plains for 17 lands.

…and Vampire Interloper for the early curve, with Falkenrath Noble, Moon Heron and Moan of the Unhallowed as finishers, Sensory Deprivation and Claustrophobia for blue answers, and Fortress Crab as a ground wall. Cut Forbidden Alchemy, Memory's Journey, Unburial Rites, and the white and red cards.

…aggro-midrange: cheap creatures, Geistflame removal, Bloodgift Demon and Falkenrath Marauders as top end, Moan for card advantage. Cut the white hedges, Traitorous Blood, Vampiric Fury, Altar's Reap and Unburial Rites to keep 23 spells with 17 lands (Stensia Bloodhall plus 8 Swamp and 8 Mountain).
